crossRefs.note: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and…

people.name: Melzar
people.line: Babylonian official in charge of Daniel and his friends.

translations.web: So the steward took away their dainties, and the wine that they would drink, and gave them vegetables.
translations.bsb: So the steward continued to withhold their choice food and the wine they were to drink, and he gave them vegetables instead.
translations.kjv: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat, and the wine that they should drink; and gave them pulse.
translations.asv: So the steward took away their dainties, and the wine that they should drink, and gave them pulse.
